title: Gen Z regelt group organises protest against military conscription in Mainz

tea.why: Protesters oppose the introduction of military conscription and are concerned about rising living costs and cuts to education policy.
tea.want: The group demands the cancellation of military conscription plans and an end to austerity measures affecting education and living standards.
tea.changed: Nov 20: A demonstration organised by Gen Z regelt is scheduled to take place in Mainz at 19:00 with approximately 1,000 participants expected.

summary: On November 20, 2026, the group Gen Z regelt has scheduled a demonstration in Mainz, Germany, to protest against military conscription. This event is part of a series of school strikes and protests occurring across seven cities in Rheinland-Pfalz, including Koblenz, Trier, and Kaiserslautern. Participants are expressing opposition to the potential reintroduction of mandatory military service, as well as concerns regarding rising living costs and budget cuts in the education sector. According to reports, approximately 1,000 people are expected to attend the evening rally in the city center. This follows a previous protest held in late October, which saw 1,200 participants according to police figures. No official response from government authorities regarding the specific demands of the current protest has been reported in the provided sources.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: A protest by Gen Z regelt is scheduled for 19:00 in Mainz, with approximately 1,000 participants expected.
